verdict: The application install exceeded the deployment type `Maximum allowed run time`. The install may still be running, may be waiting on user input, or may have hung on a pending reboot.
fix: Raise `Maximum allowed run time` on the deployment type to match the installer's worst-case (vendor installers often take 30+ minutes on first-run). Confirm the installer is silent (no GUI prompts can surface on a client). Check for pending reboots on the client that may be blocking the installer. If the installer genuinely hangs, instrument it with a wrapper that logs to a known path and retries.
